in_sanskrit.name: Saravana
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Saravana is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sarva', meaning 'all', 'whole', 'entire'. The suffix 'ana' means 'flowing', 'abundant', 'available'. Thus, Saravana means 'flowing with all', 'abundant with all', or 'available to all'. This name is often used in religious contexts and is associated with the god Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, learning, and wisdom.

in_hindi.name: Saravana
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Victory
in_hindi.long_meaning: Saravana एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who brings Victory, Prosperity and Fertility

in_tamil.name: சரவன
in_tamil.long_meaning: Saravana is a Tamil name derived from the Sanskrit word 'sarva'. In Tamil, the name is written as சரவன. The meaning of Saravana in Tamil is 'abundant', 'prosperous', or 'wealthy'. This name is often used for boys and is considered an auspicious name.
